item.description: Retail Jeweller Ed Ferris confirmed to speak at Retail Jeweller Festival 2026 Ed Ferris, former chief executive of Swag and Burrells Jewellers, has been announced as the latest speaker for the forthcoming Retail Jeweller Festival this March. item.title: Annual Careers Day returns to Birmingham Assay Office this month
item.description: Retail Jeweller Annual Careers Day returns to Birmingham Assay Office this month Birmingham Assay Office will welcome aspiring jewellery professionals and career changers to its annual Careers Day on 26 March, offering a behind-the-scenes look at opportunities within the jewellery and precious metals sector. item.title: Norqain unveils new Adventure and NEVEREST 40mm models
item.description: Retail Jeweller Norqain unveils new Adventure and NEVEREST 40mm models Independent watch brand Norqain has expanded its Adventure collection with the launch of two new 40mm models powered by the brand’s Calibre N08, alongside a limited-edition Adventure NEVEREST. Norqain unveils new Adventure and NEVEREST 40mm models Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Swiss Watchmaking Festival to take place in La Chaux-de-Fonds in December
item.description: Retail Jeweller Swiss Watchmaking Festival to take place in La Chaux-de-Fonds in December The fourth edition of the Swiss Watchmaking Festival (FHS) will be held at the Maison du Peuple in La Chaux-de-Fonds from 4 to 6 December 2026, marking a new chapter for the cultural event in the heart of Switzerland’s watchmaking metropolis. Swiss Watchmaking Festival to take place in La Chaux-de-Fonds in December Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Swarovski extends exclusive partnership with Raye for 51-date 2026 global tour
item.description: Retail Jeweller Swarovski extends exclusive partnership with Raye for 51-date 2026 global tour Crystal giant Swarovski is set to continue its exclusive partnership with award-winning singer-songwriter Raye for her highly anticipated 2026 global tour, spanning the UK, Europe and North America. Swarovski extends exclusive partnership with Raye for 51-date 2026 global tour Ruth Faulkner

item.title: HKTDC twin jewellery shows open in Hong Kong with 4,000 exhibitors
item.description: Retail Jeweller HKTDC twin jewellery shows open in Hong Kong with 4,000 exhibitors Organised by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council (HKTDC), the 12th Hong Kong International Diamond, Gem & Pearl Show has opened at AsiaWorld-Expo yesterday (2 March) and will run for five consecutive days. item.description: Retail Jeweller Maya Magal extends jewellery offer with launch of MM Studio MM Studio by Maya Magal is a new 10-piece line crafted in 18ct gold-plated recycled brass, which has been developed in response to sustained increases in precious metal prices.
